observations.text: Re-review round at clean HEAD f5279c6 (git status --porcelain: empty apart from my own .nwdes-drafts, which 7f9a111 committed by accident and which I reuse). Observations R1-R8 above are the first round at 0394a2a and stand for the parts of the candidate the rework did not touch; what follows is the delta. Delta selection, mechanical: argv 'git diff --name-only 0394a2a..f5279c6 -- crates/ xtask/' exit 0 lists exactly five files - steps/feature_instance_integration_setup.rs, tests/features/instance-integration-setup.feature, handlers/matrix_setup.rs, handlers/mod.rs, no_connection.rs; argv 'git diff --name-only 7f9a111..f5279c6' exit 0 lists only runs/review.oracle.S1.json and runs/review.oracle.S2.json, so the tail commit changes no code or test byte and the crafter's runs at 7f9a111 are runs of the bytes under review. No other production or test file changed, so nothing in my first-round judgment of the workspace page, route form, project page, templates, RELEASING.md or deploy/k8s/README.md is affected; the repository still ships no touched-file test-impact selector (unchanged from R1), so selection again came from the touched crates plus the tags on the touched feature file.

Delta code reading at f5279c6 (reviewer_reason), finding 1 and finding 3. matrix_setup.rs:282-290 now reads 'let words = cause.sentence(door.target.viewer_is_workspace_admin);' and handlers/mod.rs no longer defines Caller::viewer (the whole method is deleted), so the Send-test refusal performs no authorization read at all and the duplicate read is gone. Verified, with the claim stated exactly as the command supports it: argv 'grep -rn resolve_is_instance_admin crates/foundry-app/src/' exit 0 returns 17 lines, of which the only one under integrations/ is handlers/mod.rs:239 inside Caller::nav; the other call sites are unrelated pages (teams.rs, member_invites.rs, projects.rs, admin_tokens.rs, comments.rs, unsubscribe.rs) and nav.rs itself. The new split is behaviour-preserving, checked arm by arm: in_the_workspace(manages) returns the sentence and the workspace's own fix (Matrix NotSetUp/NoSecretsKey -> MATRIX_NOT_SET_UP/None; Slack NotSetUp -> W-2 with the guide only when manages; NoSecretsKey -> W-3/None; Unreadable -> K-19/None; NotConnected -> K-2 with Connect {kind} when manages, else K-4/None), and words(viewer) appends viewer.setup_offer() only when awaits_this_foundry(), i.e. for NotSetUp and NoSecretsKey, keeping I-19 last and never adding it to K-19, K-2 or K-4 - identical to the offers_with_setup/offers composition it replaces. sentence() is in_the_workspace(..).0, so the Send-test words still switch between K-2 and K-4 on the workspace-admin fact exactly as they ship. The five viewer.offers(None) ceremonies are gone (Vec::new() or a literal vec where the fix is structurally absent); Viewer::offers survives only where it decides something (SharedConnection::line's Connected arm). Oracle delta: the feature file gains the Scenario Outline 'A workspace admin who is not an instance admin keeps the guide on a route form, its preview and its save' with doors opens/previews/saves, asserting Tomás reads the shipped W-2 Slack sentence, 'the links Tomás is offered read "How to set up Slack"' (the whole non-sidebar offer, so an extra /admin/instance/integrations link fails the row) and that every offered link answers with its page - exactly the missing (workspace admin, not instance admin) cell on the route-form door that my finding named, on all three doors. The steps file adds only two Tomás phrases delegating to the existing iw::when_open_new_route / iw::when_post_new_route drivers; no support assertion was weakened, no row removed, no expected value moved. The tree carries no leftover mutation: route_form.rs:420 reads 'Viewer::new(self.target.viewer_is_workspace_admin, nav.is_instance_admin)' and git status shows only my own draft file modified.

Reuse at this round, cited honestly and not restamped as my own execution. Operator: the acceptance designer / crafter, in the same isolated Lima VM, at the rework tree 7f9a111 whose code and test bytes are identical to f5279c6 (git diff --name-only 7f9a111..f5279c6 shows only the two runs/review.oracle.*.json records). (1) The oracle's RED-for-the-missing-row evidence, which I read myself: /Users/jeffbailey/.cache/nwdes/iis-setup-links/mutant-probe.txt ends '19 scenarios (16 passed, 3 failed) / 192 steps (189 passed, 3 failed)' with the failing step in each of the three new rows being 'And the links Tomás is offered read "How to set up Slack"', i.e. the mutation at route_form.rs:420 that ORs the workspace-admin fact into the instance-admin fact is killed by exactly the rows my finding asked for, on all three doors; that log's trailing 'error: pathspec ... route_form.rs did not match any file(s) known to git' is a revert command run from the wrong directory, and the tree I review carries no mutation (checked above). (2) /Users/jeffbailey/.cache/nwdes/iis-setup-links/s1-tomas-green.txt ends '1 feature / 19 scenarios (19 passed) / 195 steps (195 passed)' - the us-iis-04 lane green with the three added rows. (3) Crafter rerun after the implementation rework: cargo test -p foundry-app --lib integrations::no_connection 4 passed; us-iis-04 19/19; integrations-wayfinding 54/54 (the lane that carries the Send-test refusal rows exercising the new sentence()). (4) /Users/jeffbailey/.cache/nwdes/iis-setup-links/smoke-rec.txt, read by me: 'xtask smoke :: all gates green', exit 0, at f5279c6. My own first-round executions at 0394a2a (no_connection lib 4 passed; integrations-wayfinding 54/54, 400 steps) are superseded for the two files the rework touched and remain valid for everything else; I re-executed nothing whose inputs were unchanged. typesafe: still unavailable - argv 'bash -lc echo ${TYPESAFE_API_KEY:+set}' prints nothing, so no Jev call was possible this round either and both delta questions (is the sentence()/words() split behaviour-preserving; does the Tomás outline close the AC 3 cell) were decided locally from the bytes and the recorded runs.

The two checks named as not yet run at the rework tree, executed once by this reviewer at f5279c6 (clean, only my own draft file modified). argv: timeout 5400 scripts/test-in-lima.sh bash -c 'export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4; source scripts/eip-lanes.sh; eip_warm && eip_lane instance-integration-setup; echo EXIT_IIS=$?; cargo xtask check-arch; echo EXIT_ARCH=$?' (eip_lane runs FOUNDRY_ACCEPTANCE_TAGS=instance-integration-setup timeout 2700 cargo test -p foundry-acceptance --release --test acceptance). Results: EXIT_IIS=0 with '[Summary] / 1 feature / 78 scenarios (78 passed) / 792 steps (792 passed)' - 78 and 792 against the 75/762 of my first round, the three added scenarios being the new Tomás route-form outline, and this lane carries the S2 manifest-equality scenario 'With a secrets key the page shows what to paste into Slack' whose step 'the manifest shown equals the one on the Slack setup page' passed. EXIT_ARCH=0 with 'check-arch: boundary guard PASSED (...)' including the guards this design depends on: integrations-pure-core (foundry-integrations depends only on foundry-core, serde, serde_json, async-trait, uuid, time and ipnet), integrations-store-capability, integrations-secret-seam and dependency direction - the T1 obligation that the instance-admin fact never travels down to foundry-services. stderr: cargo compile lines only; no panic, no failed step, no FAILED line in the 1396-line log.

Whole-candidate selection at clean HEAD f5279c6 (git rev-parse HEAD = f5279c6d4127d14f7633b55acdff56114fb7229e; git status --porcelain shows only my own docs/feature/iis-setup-links/.nwdes-drafts/review.candidate.json). The repository ships no touched-file test-impact selector: ls scripts -> eip-lanes.sh, slack-record.sh, test-in-lima.sh, test-vm-setup.sh; xtask carries only check_arch.rs, openapi.rs and main.rs (ci/smoke); nwdes never selects. Selection is therefore mechanical from the candidate's own paths: argv 'git diff --name-only 701c6e7..f5279c6' exit 0 lists the candidate files (RELEASING.md, deploy/k8s/README.md, crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/{no_connection.rs, handlers/{mod,workspace,route_form,routes,matrix_setup}.rs}, crates/foundry-app/templates/integrations/{workspace,route_form,project,slack_setup}.html, crates/foundry-acceptance/{tests/features/instance-integration-setup.feature, src/steps/feature_instance_integration_setup.rs, src/support/{instance_integration_setup,integrations_wayfinding}.rs}, docs/feature/iis-setup-links/*), plus .gitignore, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md from the user's unrelated commit 3eced49 which the candidate diff excludes and for which no test is selected. Mapping: the foundry-app library check for the no-connection words table (the S1 NotTested row's declared command), the acceptance tags on the touched feature file (us-iis-04 and the full instance-integration-setup lane, which also carries the S2 manifest-equality scenario), the integrations-wayfinding lane because the same ConnectionWords/project_lines/Send-test code paths are changed and its feature file is what exercises the Send-test refusal, and cargo xtask check-arch for the declared dependency-direction guard (T1). The docs/feature/** artifacts and the two operator documents carry no executable check; P6 is the examiner's.

Byte checks re-run by this reviewer at f5279c6, current evidence rather than restamped. (1) I-20: python3 comparison of the three locked sentences against crates/foundry-app/templates/integrations/slack_setup.html, the oracle table in crates/foundry-acceptance/tests/features/instance-integration-setup.feature and the locked copy row docs/feature/instance-integration-setup/discuss/user-stories.md:167 -> step3 template True feature True locked True; step4 True/True/True; footnote True/True/True, including the U+203A of 'Instance admin > Integrations'; 'Restart Foundry' in template: False. (2) P5 words unchanged: argv 'git diff 701c6e7..f5279c6 -- crates/foundry-app/src/integrations/no_connection.rs | grep -E "^[-+]pub const"' exit 0 returns exactly one line, the added '+pub const SET_UP_INTEGRATIONS: &str = "Set up integrations for this Foundry"'; no W-2, W-3, K-2, K-4 or K-19 string is added or removed anywhere in the candidate, and I-19's target is INSTANCE_PATH = /admin/instance/integrations as the locked I-19 row states. (3) Unchanged-input comparison for the parts of the candidate the rework did not touch: argv 'git diff --name-only 0394a2a..f5279c6 -- handlers/workspace.rs handlers/route_form.rs handlers/routes.rs crates/foundry-app/templates/ RELEASING.md deploy/k8s/README.md' exit 0 prints nothing, so those bytes are exactly the ones I read in the previous round and my reading of them is current.

Whole-candidate code reading, current at f5279c6 (the files named here are byte-identical to those I read before, established by the empty git diff --name-only 0394a2a..f5279c6 over them). (a) Workspace page: the removed template flags not_set_up/no_secrets_key/matrix_not_set_up are replaced by slack_no_connection = of_slack(offer, slack.is_some()).filter(awaits_this_foundry).map(words(viewer)) and the Matrix equivalent; arm by arm - SlackOffer::NotSetUp -> Some(W-2), as before independent of an existing connection; NoSecretsKey -> Some(W-3); Unavailable -> Unreadable, filtered out, so the shipped unavailable arm at workspace.html:8 and the Add-to-Slack fallback at :15-16 behave as they ship; Ready+unconnected -> NotConnected, filtered out -> Add to Slack; MatrixOffer::NoSecretsKey -> NotSetUp(Matrix) -> W-2 Matrix; Matrix Unavailable/Ready filtered out. No arm changes for a viewer who is not an instance admin. (b) Viewer::new(true, nav.is_instance_admin) on that page is sound: caller.services.workspace_integrations() answers Err for a non-workspace-admin and the handler returns refusal(err) before the page is built, and the shipped template offered 'How to set up Slack' unconditionally there, so no link is widened. (c) route_form.rs:420 reads Viewer::new(self.target.viewer_is_workspace_admin, nav.is_instance_admin) and one RouteFormPage builder serves the form GET, the preview and the save, which is what makes the three doors agree. (d) The ConnectionWords.fix -> fixes widening is a loop in each of the three templates; every shipped project-page, route-form and workspace row stays at one link or none. (e) Test-side: the only changed support assertions are additions (then_reads_in_order, then_reads_nothing_saying, Offered/then_page_links/then_each_link_opens, page_in_front_of). page_in_front_of widens the shared precondition from status.is_success() to (success or 422) and adds a text/html content type and a non-empty body; AC 2 requires it because the save refuses in place with 422, and the product assertions it guards (which links, in which order, and that each followed link answers 200) are unchanged, so it is not a net weakening of the shipped scenarios that share it. No test was skipped, softened, narrowed or deleted, no case removed and no expected value moved to match output; the oracle and its supports are the acceptance designer's and the candidate adds no test path beyond them.

diagnostic: Accepted at f5279c6, no finding left open. All three findings of my REJECT round are resolved in the bytes, each by the remediation it asked for, and nothing else of the candidate changed: git diff --name-only 0394a2a..f5279c6 -- crates/ xtask/ lists exactly five files and 7f9a111..f5279c6 only the two oracle re-approval records. (1) Oracle finding: the feature file gains the Scenario Outline 'A workspace admin who is not an instance admin keeps the guide on a route form, its preview and its save' over opens/previews/saves, asserting the shipped W-2 Slack sentence, 'the links Tomas is offered read "How to set up Slack"' - the whole non-sidebar offer, so an extra /admin/instance/integrations link fails the row - and that every offered link answers with its page: exactly the (workspace admin, not instance admin) cell on the route-form door that AC 3 names, on all three doors, with the matching Tested row added to the acceptance record for P3/P5. Its discrimination is demonstrated, not asserted: the recorded probe mutation at route_form.rs:420 leaves 16 passed and 3 failed, each failure being that link list. (2) Implementation finding 1: Caller::viewer is deleted and the Send-test refusal reads cause.sentence(door.target.viewer_is_workspace_admin), so the path performs no authorization read at all; the only remaining call site of resolve_is_instance_admin under integrations/ is Caller::nav. (3) Implementation finding 3: the five viewer.offers(None) ceremonies are gone and Viewer::offers remains only where it decides something. The sentence()/words() split is behaviour-preserving by construction: one private in_the_workspace(manages) owns every sentence and workspace fix, sentence() is its first element, words() appends Viewer::setup_offer only when awaits_this_foundry(), so I-19 stays last and never reaches K-19, K-2 or K-4, and the K-2/K-4 switch on the workspace-admin fact is unchanged; declared law L7 carries Evidence None, which is honest and sufficient because the projection is literally the first element of the one tuple both consumers share and cannot diverge without rewriting that single function. Checks I executed once at this HEAD: the full instance-integration-setup lane, 78 scenarios / 792 steps all passed, exit 0, including the S2 manifest-equality scenario; cargo xtask check-arch, PASSED, exit 0, with the integrations-pure-core and dependency-direction guards the T1 obligation rests on. Reused with the unchanged-byte comparison recorded, operator the crafter at 7f9a111: no_connection lib 4 passed, us-iis-04 19/19 (195 steps), integrations-wayfinding 54/54; plus xtask smoke 'all gates green' at f5279c6. Byte checks re-run here: the three locked I-20 sentences are identical in template, oracle and locked copy row, 'Restart Foundry' is gone, and the only constant added across the candidate is SET_UP_INTEGRATIONS -> /admin/instance/integrations, so W-2, W-3, K-2, K-4 and K-19 keep their shipped words. The workspace page's new Option<ConnectionWords> arms are state-by-state equivalent to the three flags they replace, Viewer::new(true, nav.is_instance_admin) there is sound because the services view refuses a non-workspace-admin before the page is built, and page_in_front_of's widening is required by AC 2's 422 save while adding a content-type and non-empty-body requirement, so no shipped scenario loses discrimination. Preserved limitations: typesafe: unavailable (TYPESAFE_API_KEY absent, client exit 3), so every reviewer question was decided locally and labelled reviewer_reason; P6 (RELEASING.md R-1/R-2 and deploy/k8s/README.md) stays examiner-owned with no executable check - I read both and the browser-first instructions, the optional SLACK_* trio and the added Matrix sentence are present and consistent.
